guide.en:
Install

From Releases, download one of:

  • Installer (recommended): XIVChatNext-win-Setup.exe. It installs for the current user in %LOCALAPPDATA%\XIVChatNext without administrator rights, adds desktop and Start menu shortcuts, and can update itself. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the installer is not code-signed; choose More info → Run anyway. Uninstall from Settings → Apps; chat history and settings in %LOCALAPPDATA%\XIVChatDesktop are kept.
  • Portable ZIP: XIVChatNext-Desktop-…-win-x64.zip. Extract it into its own directory and run XIVChat Desktop.exe. Keep all files and folders, including runtime. It does not update itself.

.NET and Windows App SDK are included in both; web cards also require Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.

Add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AinaSnow/FFXIV-Dalamud-Plugins/main/pluginmaster.json to Dalamud's custom plugin repositories. Install XIVChatNext Server, log in, and use matching client/plugin versions from the same release.

Connect

The first-run guide sets language, connection and notifications; reopen it from Settings. The desktop supports English, Simplified Chinese and System. New plugin configurations default to English and have an independent language setting.

Use 127.0.0.1:14777 on the same PC, unless the port was changed. On a reachable network, use the game PC's address; from plugin 1.7.17, first turn on Allow LAN connections in the plugin's Connection settings (new plugin configurations accept only same-PC connections, existing ones keep LAN access). Ports must match. Compare fingerprints and confirm trust on both ends.

Without direct access, choose Self-hosted relay, paste a fresh invitation from your relay administrator, independently compare the endpoint fingerprint with the plugin and save. Complete the chat-device trust confirmation too. Saved pairing survives normal restarts; re-pair after loss, revocation or identity changes. See Relay.

Click the Logo to reconnect to the most recently successful target. Interrupted successful relay sessions retry; explicit Disconnect cancels retries. Reopening the app does not send chat or log in to the game.

Everyday use

Area Action
Conversations Open tells, pin contacts and check unread counts. Confirm the fixed recipient above the composer.
Channels Select the sending channel and customize views/filters.
Friends Open a conversation from synced friends. Unknown/expired presence is not proof of being offline.
History Choose a character/source, search and read saved messages offline.
Favorites Save messages/cards and add notes.
Events Review events and configure notifications in Settings.

Open conversations as popouts and save/restore layouts. They share conversation state and preserve disconnected drafts. Reading another character's history does not switch the live sender.

Select item/map links to inspect cards; comparisons depend on available data/equipment. Request a screenshot from the client, then preview, save or copy it. Any trusted client can request screenshots while the game and plugin are running; from plugin 1.8.0 you can turn this off in the plugin's Messages tab.

Contact nicknames and streamer mode (Desktop 1.4.0)

Right-click a friend or conversation and choose Contact nickname, or use the nickname button in a conversation. Names must fit on one line, up to 64 characters. Clear the field to restore the character name. Nicknames belong to the connection and current character; they also work for friends without saved messages. They do not replace long notes or change the tell recipient. Friend/conversation search accepts both nicknames and real names. Ordinary history search, copying and exports retain original identities when streamer mode is off.

Toggle Streamer mode at the top of the main window. In Settings, choose whether to hide yourself, other players, or both, and optionally set your own display name. Both scopes default on. The app remembers the setting before reopening its windows. Protected players use stable pseudonyms, with their server and avatar hidden; pseudonyms take precedence over nicknames. Open popouts update with the main window.

The same display rules apply to known complete names in chat text, previews, history, favorites, events, notifications, selected/copied text and TXT/RTF exports. Ambiguous names use a generic anonymous label. Switching the policy clears this app's previous notifications, clears export previews and cancels running exports. Already copied text, saved files and notifications outside the app's control cannot be recalled.

This is not automatic image or free-text redaction. Game screenshots remain unchanged. Unknown nicknames, unrecognized names, images, search fields and text you type may still identify someone. Turn streamer mode off to edit stored notes, nicknames or avatar mappings; an open identity editor closes when it is enabled. The database keeps original messages. Check the actual screen or export before sharing.

Update checks (Desktop 1.4.1)

The client checks public GitHub releases shortly after startup. If a newer Windows client is available, a dismissible banner opens Settings → Updates, where you can read the release notes and open the download. This page also shows the current version and a Check for updates button. Turn off Check for updates at startup to use manual checks only; the preference saves immediately. Failed checks do not interrupt chat. In the installed version, Download and install downloads the update only after you click it, then closes the client the normal way and restarts on the new version. The portable ZIP opens the download in your browser instead.

Only stable Windows desktop packages are compared, independently of plugin version tags. Checking sends no chat or character information. Downloads open in your browser; extract into a new folder and close the current client before starting the new version. The client does not replace itself automatically.

Tray and global shortcut (Desktop 1.5.0)

In Settings → Window, turn on Keep running in the notification area to close the main window without exiting. Click the tray icon to show or hide the window; right-click it for Exit. Hover the icon to see unread tells.

Turn on Global shortcut and press a combination in the shortcut field (Ctrl+Alt+X by default). The shortcut shows the window with the message box focused, and hides it again when the window is already in front. It works while the game is focused, so pick a combination the game does not use. If another application already owns it, the settings page says so.

Export chat history

Open the export window from the export button in a conversation or channel header, from Settings → History → Export chat history…, or from the XIVChat Next ▾ menu next to the logo. It exports what you are looking at: the open conversation, channel, history search or favorite. Narrow it by keyword and time, choose whether to include timestamps, preview the last 100 lines, then save.

Choose the format in the save dialog: Text (.txt), Markdown (.md) or Rich Text (.rtf). Every format writes each message as time [channel] sender: message, with the channel named in the interface language. Linkshell and cross-world linkshell messages also show the linkshell's name, for example [Cross-world Linkshell [1] · Shell name]; the plugin records it with each message from plugin 1.8.0, so earlier messages show the channel only. Markdown adds a title, groups messages under a heading per day and escapes chat text so it displays literally. With streamer mode on, exports use the same hidden names as the screen and omit linkshell names.

Translation and AI summaries (Desktop 1.6.0)

Optional and off by default. In Settings → Translation & AI, turn on Enable translation and AI summaries, choose the services and save. Nothing is sent automatically, and with streamer mode on, names are hidden the same way as in exports before text is sent. Keys are encrypted for your Windows account and never shown again; leave a key field empty to keep the saved key.

Translation uses one of:

Service What you enter Notes
Google Translate (free) Nothing Uses Google's unpublished web endpoint: it may stop working at any time, Google's terms do not cover automated use, and it needs a proxy in mainland China.
Microsoft Translator Azure Translator key, region for regional resources 2 million characters a month free; usually reachable from mainland China.
DeepL Authentication key 500,000 characters a month on the free plan (keys ending in :fx).
Baidu Translate APP ID and secret key Reachable from mainland China, with a monthly free allowance.
Tencent Translate SecretId, SecretKey, optional region Reachable from mainland China, with a monthly free allowance.
The AI service See below Best at keeping game terms and names.

Right-click a message, or select text in it, and choose Translate. The translation appears under the original; only that message is sent. Translate and summarize into picks the language; Interface language follows the app. Test translation checks the service with one short sentence.

AI summaries use the AI service: Claude with your own Anthropic API key (default model claude-opus-5-5), or an OpenAI-compatible service or local model (service address ending in /v1, model name, and a key if needed; plain http:// only for a model on this computer, such as Ollama). Open the export window for a conversation, channel or history search, narrow it by time or keyword, and choose AI summary to read and copy it. Tick Add AI summary to Markdown export and save as .md to put it at the top of the file with a note that it may be wrong. Very large ranges are refused rather than cut short. Paid services bill your own account.

Data and upgrades

History, favorites, notes and layouts stay local; the relay is not cloud history sync. Configuration: %APPDATA%\XIVChat for Windows. Data: %LOCALAPPDATA%\XIVChatDesktop. Do not publicly share these files. Protected relay credentials belong to the current Windows user.

The installed version updates from Settings → Updates. For the portable ZIP, close the client normally and back up configuration/data before upgrading, then extract the new package into a separate directory; never mix runtime DLLs. Update the plugin in Dalamud and retain the old client package for rollback.

Desktop 1.4.0 remains compatible with plugin 1.7.15 and upgrades the history database from schema v5 to v6. Migration makes a *.before-v6-*.bak backup next to the database. To roll back, close the client and restore the previous configuration and database together with the previous executable; do not open the v6 database with an older client. Keep a copy of the current data first, since restoring a backup omits messages saved after that backup.

Desktop 1.5.0 encrypts the device private key for the current Windows user on first start. A 1.4.x client cannot read the migrated configuration; restore the configuration backed up before upgrading if you roll back.

Live sending, friends and screenshots require the game, logged-in character and plugin. This app cannot keep a character logged in or send after the game closes. Game/Dalamud updates may require a plugin update.
guide.zh:
先安装客户端和插件

打开 下载页面，二选一：

  • 安装版（推荐）：下载 XIVChatNext-win-Setup.exe 双击运行。程序只为当前用户安装到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\XIVChatNext，不需要管理员权限，会创建桌面和开始菜单快捷方式，之后可以在客户端里直接更新。安装包没有代码签名，Windows 可能弹出 SmartScreen 提示，点“更多信息 → 仍要运行”即可。卸载在“设置 → 应用”里进行，%LOCALAPPDATA%\XIVChatDesktop 中的聊天记录和配置会保留。
  • 免安装版：下载 XIVChatNext-Desktop-…-win-x64.zip，解压到一个新文件夹后运行 XIVChat Desktop.exe。不要只拿出 EXE，旁边的文件和文件夹（包括 runtime）都要保留。免安装版不会自动更新。

客户端已带有所需的 .NET 和 Windows App SDK。物品、地图等网页卡片还需要 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime。

在 Dalamud 设置 → 实验性功能 → 自定义插件仓库中，添加下面的地址，再安装 XIVChatNext Server：

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AinaSnow/FFXIV-Dalamud-Plugins/main/pluginmaster.json

登录游戏角色，在插件设置中启用连接。客户端和插件请使用同一次发布的版本。

第一次连接

客户端第一次启动时，会引导你选择语言、连接方式和通知，以后可以从设置里重新打开。客户端支持简体中文、英文和跟随系统；插件新配置默认英文，语言可以单独设置。

**客户端和游戏在同一台电脑上：**地址填 127.0.0.1，默认端口填 14777。如果改过插件端口，这里也要改成一样的。

**客户端在另一台局域网电脑上：**插件 1.7.17 起，先在插件“连接”设置中开启“允许局域网设备连接”（旧版本的配置升级后自动保持开启），再填写游戏电脑的局域网地址，端口与插件一致。两台电脑需要能够互相访问。

第一次连接时，对照客户端和插件显示的设备指纹。确认一致后，在两边允许连接并保存信任。

**无法直接访问游戏电脑：**可以选择“自建中继”，粘贴你生成的邀请，再按提示核对指纹并完成配对。中继需要自己部署，具体见 中继使用说明。

以后点击左上角 Logo，就能连接上次成功使用的地址。中继连接意外断开后会自动重试；点击主动断开后停止重试。正常重启不需要重新配对，重新打开客户端也不会自动发消息或替你登录游戏。

平时怎么用

位置 可以做什么
会话 给好友发悄悄话、置顶常聊的人、查看未读消息。发送前看清楚收件人。
频道 选择要看的消息类型和发送频道。
好友 查看从游戏同步的好友，选中后打开私聊。“未知”或“已过期”表示没有拿到最新状态，不代表好友离线。
历史 按角色和连接来源查看记录，用关键词搜索。已经保存的记录可以离线查看。
收藏 保存消息或物品、地图卡片，也可以写备注。
事件 查看游戏和连接事件，通知方式可以在设置中调整。

聊天可以打开为独立小窗，窗口位置可以保存并在下次恢复。主窗口和小窗使用同一段会话，断线后草稿会保留。查看其他角色的历史记录，不会切换当前发消息的角色。

点击消息里的物品或坐标可以看详情。装备对比需要游戏提供相应数据。在客户端请求截图，收到后可以预览、保存或复制。游戏和插件运行时，所有已信任的客户端都可以请求截图；插件 1.8.0 起可以在插件“消息”页关闭。

点击发送按钮左侧的笑脸可以打开“游戏符号”，主窗口和小窗都能用。选中的符号会插入到光标位置，或替换选中的文字，之后仍需要你自己发送。面板收录当前字体能显示的 165 个游戏专用字符和《》，范围参考 Lodestone 符号清单，游戏里最终怎么显示取决于游戏版本。

备注名和主播模式（客户端 1.4.0）

右键点击好友或会话可以设置备注名，最多 64 个字符，清空后恢复角色名。备注名按连接和当前角色分别保存，没聊过天的好友也能设置。它与原有的长文本备注分开保存，不会改变实际收件人。好友和会话搜索可以输入备注名或真实姓名。

主窗口顶部可以开关主播模式。在设置里选择隐藏自己、其他玩家或两者都隐藏，也能设置自己的显示名称。被隐藏的玩家使用固定化名，服务器和头像一并隐藏，化名优先于备注名。主窗口、小窗、历史、收藏、事件、通知、已知完整姓名、复制聊天和 TXT/RTF 导出使用同一规则。重启后会记住开关状态。

国服战斗记录里的“发动了”“附加效果”等角色位置也会隐藏；无法确认身份的战斗对象显示为“匿名玩家”，个别怪物名称也可能被匿名。带跨服图标的名字和服务器会一起隐藏，感情动作的发起者和目标也会处理。普通聊天里的类似句子不会被当成战斗记录。

切换隐私设置会清理本应用之前发出的通知，并取消正在进行的导出。已经复制或保存到外部的内容无法撤回。游戏截图不会自动打码，未知昵称、图片、搜索框和正在输入的文字也不会自动隐藏。本地数据库仍保留原始记录。开启时不能编辑备注名、备注或头像绑定，分享前请检查实际画面。

更新检查（客户端 1.4.1）

启动后会在后台检查 GitHub 上的公开版本。发现新版时，主窗口显示可关闭的提示，点击后进入“设置 → 更新”，可以查看更新说明或打开下载。这一页也能手动检查，或者关闭启动检查。检查只比较正式发布的客户端版本，不发送聊天或角色信息，失败也不影响聊天。安装版点“下载并更新”后才开始下载，下载完成后客户端会正常退出，并自动以新版本重新启动。免安装版则在浏览器中打开下载，客户端不会替换自己。

托盘和全局快捷键（客户端 1.5.0）

在“设置 → 窗口”中开启“关闭主窗口时保留在通知区域（托盘）”，关闭主窗口后程序继续运行。单击托盘图标显示或隐藏窗口，右键可退出；鼠标悬停可以看到未读私聊数。

开启“使用全局快捷键”（默认 Ctrl+Alt+X），点一下快捷键框再按组合键就能修改。按下后显示窗口并聚焦输入框，窗口已在最前时再按一次会隐藏。快捷键在游戏中同样生效，请避开游戏里正在使用的按键；如果已被其他程序占用，设置页会提示。两项默认关闭。

导出聊天记录

可以从会话或频道标题栏右侧的导出按钮、“设置 → 历史 → 导出聊天记录…”，或者 Logo 旁边的 “XIVChat Next ▾” 菜单打开导出窗口。导出的是你当前正在看的内容：打开的会话、频道、历史搜索结果或收藏。可以按关键词和时间缩小范围，选择是否带时间，预览最后 100 行后再保存。

在保存对话框里选择格式：文本 (.txt)、Markdown (.md) 或 RTF (.rtf)。每种格式中，每条消息都是 时间 [频道] 发送者: 内容，频道按界面语言显示。通讯贝和跨界通讯贝的消息还会带上贝的名字，例如 [跨界通讯贝 [1] · 贝名]；插件 1.8.0 起会随每条消息记录贝名，更早的消息只显示频道。Markdown 会加上标题、按日期分组，并对聊天内容做转义，保证原样显示。开启主播模式时，导出内容和屏幕上一样隐藏名字，也不显示贝名。

翻译和 AI 总结（客户端 1.6.0）

可选功能，默认关闭。在“设置 → 翻译与 AI”中开启“启用翻译和 AI 总结”，选好服务后保存。不会自动发送任何内容；开启主播模式时，发送前会像导出一样隐藏名字。密钥按你的 Windows 账户加密保存，之后不会再显示；密钥框留空则保持已保存的密钥。

翻译可以选择：

服务 需要填写 说明
谷歌翻译（免费） 无 使用谷歌未公开的网页接口：随时可能失效，谷歌条款不涵盖这种自动调用，在中国大陆需要代理。
微软翻译 Azure 翻译密钥；区域资源需要填写区域 每月 200 万字符免费，在中国大陆通常可以直接访问。
DeepL 认证密钥 免费版每月 50 万字符（密钥以 :fx 结尾）。
百度翻译 APP ID 和密钥 中国大陆可直接访问，每月有免费额度。
腾讯翻译 SecretId、SecretKey，可选地域 中国大陆可直接访问，每月有免费额度。
使用 AI 服务 见下方 对游戏术语和角色名保留得最好。

在消息上右键，或选中其中的文字后右键，选择“翻译”，译文显示在原文下方，只会发送这一条消息。“翻译和总结使用的语言”选择目标语言，“跟随界面语言”则与客户端一致。“测试翻译”会用一句简短的话检查服务是否可用。

AI 总结使用 AI 服务：Claude（填写自己的 Anthropic API Key，默认模型 claude-opus-5-5），或 OpenAI 兼容服务或本机模型（以 /v1 结尾的服务地址、模型名称，需要时填写 Key；只有本机模型允许 http://，例如 Ollama）。为会话、频道或历史搜索打开导出窗口，按时间或关键词缩小范围后点“AI 总结”，可以查看和复制。勾选“导出 Markdown 时附带 AI 总结”并保存为 .md，总结会放在文件开头，并注明可能有误。范围太大时会直接提示缩小范围，不会悄悄截断。收费服务由你自己的账号计费。

数据存在哪里

历史、收藏、备注和窗口布局都保存在运行客户端的电脑上，中继不提供云同步。

  • 配置：%APPDATA%\XIVChat for Windows
  • 聊天记录等数据：%LOCALAPPDATA%\XIVChatDesktop

这些目录含有聊天记录和连接信息，请不要公开上传。本设备密钥和中继凭据只能由保存它的 Windows 用户读取，直接复制到另一台电脑或另一个用户下无法使用，需要重新确认信任或重新配对。

怎么升级

安装版在“设置 → 更新”中直接更新。免安装版请先正常退出客户端，备份上面的两个目录，再把新版解压到新的文件夹，不要混用旧版 DLL。插件通过 Dalamud 更新，客户端和插件请使用同一次发布的版本。保留旧安装包，方便回退。

  • 客户端 1.4.0 会把历史数据库从 v5 升到 v6，升级前自动生成 *.before-v6-*.bak 备份。不要用旧客户端打开 v6 数据库。
  • 客户端 1.5.0 首次启动时会把本设备私钥改为加密保存，1.4.x 客户端读不了迁移后的配置。

回退时，把旧客户端和升级前备份的配置、数据库一起恢复。恢复备份会失去备份之后新增的本地记录，所以先另外保存一份当前数据。

收发新消息、刷新好友和获取截图，都需要游戏运行、角色在线、插件正常加载。客户端不能让角色保持在线，也不能在游戏关闭后代发消息。游戏或 Dalamud 更新后，可能需要更新插件。

relay.en:
The plugin and desktop both connect to your HTTPS server when the game PC is not directly reachable. The relay forwards application traffic; it does not proxy the game, keep a character logged in, or store offline chats/screenshots.

Deploy

Use the Ubuntu + 1Panel offline image guide for the release's prebuilt Linux amd64 image. For source builds and 1Panel HTTPS setup, see VPS HTTPS.

On a server without an existing reverse proxy, the repository's default deploy/relay/compose.yaml includes Caddy. In that directory, copy .env.example to .env, set a real RELAY_DOMAIN and independent RELAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD (at least 16 characters), then run docker compose up -d --build. Caddy needs inbound 80/443; do not publish game port 14777 or backend 8080. Do not combine this default configuration with the 1Panel-only configuration.

Open https://your-domain/admin/ and sign in with the administrator password. Use the HTTPS root address as the service URL, without a subpath, query, username or password. Plain HTTP is allowed only for local development on loopback.

Register the game and pair the desktop

  1. In Game devices, add a named device and save the registration credential shown only once.
  2. Enter the service URL/credential in the plugin, save and enable Relay. Wait for the device to show online.
  3. Generate an invitation in the web admin or plugin. A new invitation invalidates the previous unused invitation.
  4. In the desktop, choose Self-hosted relay and paste the invitation. Compare the complete endpoint fingerprint with the plugin through an independent trusted channel, then save.
  5. Complete the existing chat-device trust confirmation on both ends.

Registration, invitations and desktop credentials are separate from the admin password. Each desktop has its own credential. Credentials are protected for the current Windows user; moving PCs/users or losing configuration may require new pairing.

A normal restart does not require another invitation. The ten-minute invitation lifetime applies only to its first, one-time exchange. Saved credentials and trust remain valid until revoked. Configuration save failure, revoked/lost credentials or a replaced endpoint certificate can require re-pairing.

After a successful session, the Logo can connect to the last successful target. Interrupted successful relay sessions retry with backoff; explicit Disconnect cancels retries.

Administration and operation

The English/Chinese web admin lists devices, clients and live sessions. Rename devices, create invitations, revoke a client or revoke a whole game device. Original credentials cannot be displayed again. Revocation normally closes affected sessions within the two-second checking interval; it cannot be undone.

Admin sessions last at most eight hours and end on logout or server restart. Restarting the server does not erase device/client authorization. To change the password, update the deployment environment and recreate the relay container. With Compose, provide the original domain and chosen password again when recreating it.

Defaults are intended for small private deployments: 64 online game hosts, 32 clients/sessions per host, 256 total sessions, and 4 MiB/s per session/direction with an 8 MiB burst. Large screenshots share their session with chat. Request/rate limits can apply per instance behind a shared proxy.

Backup, upgrade and troubleshooting

Retain the data volume and the existing image. Stop relay writes before copying SQLite; do not copy only a live main database while omitting its WAL. A sample Compose backup is:

mkdir -p backups
docker compose stop relay
docker compose cp relay:/data/relay.sqlite3 ./backups/relay.sqlite3
docker compose start relay

Keep configuration/volumes for upgrades and restore a matching pre-upgrade data snapshot for rollback when schemas change. Never remove the volume as part of routine upgrades.

Symptom Check
Wrong admin address Configured HTTPS domain and forwarded original Host
Login failure / 429 Password and login rate limit; wait a minute before retrying
Plugin offline / 409 HTTPS reachability, registration credential and endpoint certificate
401 Lost, incorrect or revoked credential
Invitation rejected Expired, used, replaced, incompatible or client limit reached
Connected but cannot send Character login and trust confirmation on both ends
Fingerprint mismatch Stop and independently compare with the plugin; do not bypass it

The relay sees addresses, timing, device identifiers and traffic sizes. Application data uses an additional endpoint TLS session and the existing chat encryption; the relay does not hold endpoint private keys or persist application traffic.
relay.zh:
如果你在外面，客户端无法直接连接家里的游戏电脑，可以在自己的服务器上部署中继。客户端和游戏插件都连接它，再通过它传递消息。

中继需要自己部署，不是公共服务。游戏仍然要保持运行，角色仍然要在线。中继不能帮你登录游戏，也不会保存离线聊天或截图。

选择一种安装方式

**使用 1Panel：**按 1Panel 离线部署教程 导入发布包里的 Linux amd64 镜像，并设置域名和 HTTPS。

**普通 Docker 服务器：**如果没有现成的反向代理，可以使用项目里的 deploy/relay/compose.yaml，它包含 Caddy。把 .env.example 复制为 .env，填写你的 RELAY_DOMAIN 和至少 16 个字符的独立管理密码 RELAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD，再运行 docker compose up -d --build。具体步骤见 HTTPS 部署教程。

Caddy 需要使用服务器的 80、443 端口，不需要把 14777、8080 开放到公网。已有 1Panel 反向代理时，请使用对应教程，不要再叠加这一套 Caddy 配置。

部署完成后，打开 https://你的域名/admin/，用管理密码登录。客户端和插件里填写的服务地址是 https://你的域名，不要带 /admin/、其他路径或用户名密码。只有在本机开发时才能使用回环地址的 HTTP。

把游戏电脑和客户端连上

  1. 在后台的“游戏设备”里添加设备，保存页面显示的注册凭据。它只显示一次。
  2. 在游戏插件里填写中继地址和注册凭据，保存并启用中继，等后台显示设备在线。
  3. 在后台或插件中生成邀请。生成新邀请后，上一份尚未使用的邀请会失效。
  4. 在客户端选择“自建中继”，粘贴邀请。直接对照游戏插件显示的完整指纹，确认一致后保存；不在游戏电脑旁边时，通过你信任的渠道核对。
  5. 按客户端和插件的提示，完成第一次聊天连接的信任确认。

管理密码用来登录后台；注册凭据交给游戏插件；邀请交给新客户端。这几种内容不能互相替代。每个客户端有自己的凭据，只能由保存它的 Windows 用户使用；换电脑、换用户或丢失配置后需要重新配对。

正常重启不需要重新邀请。 邀请的十分钟有效期只限制第一次使用。配对信息保存成功后，邀请过期不会让已有连接失效。清空配置、撤销授权或更换设备身份后，才可能需要重新配对。

点击客户端左上角 Logo 可以连接上次成功使用的地址。中继连接意外断开后会自动重试；主动断开后停止重试。

后台能做什么

后台支持中英文，可以查看在线设备和连接、重命名设备、生成邀请，也可以撤销某个客户端或整个游戏设备的授权。撤销通常在两秒内生效，被撤销的凭据不能恢复。之前的原始凭据不会再次显示。

后台登录最多保持八小时，退出登录或重启服务后需要重新登录，但设备配对不会因此丢失。修改管理密码后，需要用更新后的环境变量重新创建容器；使用 Compose 时，重建时要再次提供域名和你保存的密码。

默认配置适合个人或小规模使用：最多 64 个在线游戏设备，每个设备最多 32 个客户端会话，整个服务最多 256 个会话。每个会话每个方向限速 4 MiB/s，允许 8 MiB 突发流量。截图和聊天共用连接，部分请求还受整个服务的频率限制。

备份和升级

升级前保存配置、数据卷和旧镜像。备份数据库时，先停止中继再复制数据；不要只复制运行中的 SQLite 主文件，否则可能漏掉还在 WAL 文件里的内容。使用 Compose 时可以这样备份：

mkdir -p backups
docker compose stop relay
docker compose cp relay:/data/relay.sqlite3 ./backups/relay.sqlite3
docker compose start relay

正常升级应保留数据卷，不要删除它。数据库结构升级后，如果要回退旧版中继，也要恢复升级前的数据备份。

连不上时先查什么

  • **后台地址打不开：**检查 HTTPS 域名配置，以及反向代理是否转发了原始 Host。
  • **后台登录失败或提示 429：**检查管理密码，连续失败后等一分钟再试。
  • **游戏设备离线或提示 409：**检查插件是否启用中继，服务地址、注册凭据和 HTTPS 证书是否正确。
  • **提示 401：**凭据可能无效或已被撤销，需要检查授权。
  • **邀请不能用：**检查是否过期、已使用、生成了新的邀请，或客户端数量已达上限。
  • **连接成功但发不出消息：**检查角色是否在线，两端是否都完成了信任确认。
  • **指纹不一致：**先停止连接，重新核对游戏插件的指纹，不要跳过检查。

中继能看到连接地址、时间、设备标识和流量大小。聊天等应用数据在两端之间另有 TLS 和原有聊天加密，中继不持有设备私钥，也不把这些流量保存为聊天记录。

privacy.en:
XIVChat Next has no account, no analytics and no cloud service run by the project. Your chats travel between the game plugin and your own desktop, directly or through a relay you host yourself.

What stays on your computer

  • Desktop client: settings, saved connections and trusted devices in %APPDATA%\XIVChat for Windows. From Desktop 1.5.0 the device private key is encrypted for your Windows account. History, favorites, notes, nicknames, window layouts and cached images are in %LOCALAPPDATA%\XIVChatDesktop. None of this is uploaded.
  • Game plugin: settings, trusted devices and its key are stored with your other Dalamud plugin settings; relay credentials are protected for your Windows account. Recent messages are kept in memory so a reconnecting client can catch up; the amount is set in the plugin's Messages tab and is cleared when the plugin stops.

These folders contain chat history and connection secrets. Do not share them publicly.

Connections

  • First connection: the client and the plugin each show a fingerprint. Compare them and approve on both ends. Only approve devices you recognise; remove old ones in the plugin's Devices tab.
  • Encryption: chat traffic between the client and the plugin is encrypted, whether you connect directly or through a relay. From Desktop 1.6.0 and plugin 1.8.0 (encryption v2), every connection uses new keys, recorded traffic cannot be replayed, and past sessions stay private if a device key later leaks. Older versions use the original encryption (v1) without these protections; the plugin's Devices tab shows which devices still use it. See Chat encryption v2.
  • Direct connections: from plugin 1.7.17, new plugin configurations accept connections from this computer only. Turn on Allow LAN connections only if another computer on your network needs to connect. The plugin limits repeated connection attempts and trust prompts from unknown devices.
  • Relay: a relay you host sees connection addresses, timing, device identifiers and traffic sizes. It does not hold device private keys and does not store chats. See Self-hosted relay.

What the client fetches from the internet

Feature Service What is sent Control
Update checks GitHub (api.github.com) An ordinary request for the public release list. No chat or character information. Settings → Updates → turn off the startup check
Online avatars Lodestone (na.finalfantasyxiv.com) Names and home worlds of characters shown in the client, to find their portraits Settings → History → Allow online Lodestone avatar lookups
Item and map cards xivapi.com, cafemaker.wakingsands.com, xivapi-v2.xivcdn.com Item, icon and map identifiers Images are cached locally after the first download
Map links map.wakingsands.com Map identifier and coordinates, when you open a map card's web view Only when you open it
Translation (Desktop 1.6.0) The service you choose: Google (translate.googleapis.com), Microsoft (api.cognitive.microsofttranslator.com), DeepL (api.deepl.com / api-free.deepl.com), Baidu (fanyi-api.baidu.com), Tencent (tmt.tencentcloudapi.com) or the AI service The message you choose to translate, with names hidden when streamer mode is on Off by default; only sent when you ask
AI summaries (Desktop 1.6.0) The AI service you set: Anthropic (api.anthropic.com) or the OpenAI-compatible address you enter The history range you choose to summarize, with names hidden when streamer mode is on Off by default; only sent when you ask

Like any web request, these services also see your IP address.

Screenshots and streamer mode

The plugin captures the game window when a trusted client asks for a screenshot. From plugin 1.8.0 you can turn this off with Allow clients to request game screenshots in the plugin's Messages tab; earlier versions have no switch, so only trust devices you control. Streamer mode changes what the client displays, copies and exports. It does not redact game screenshots, images, unknown nicknames or text you type, and local history keeps the original messages. Check the actual screen before sharing.

Reporting a security problem

Please do not post details publicly. Open an issue that only says you have a security report, and a private channel will be arranged.
privacy.zh:
XIVChat Next 没有账号，不做统计，也没有项目方运营的云服务。聊天只在游戏插件和你自己的电脑之间传递，可以直连，也可以经过你自己部署的中继。

哪些内容保存在本机

  • **桌面客户端：**设置、保存的连接和已信任设备在 %APPDATA%\XIVChat for Windows。客户端 1.5.0 起，本设备私钥按你的 Windows 账户加密保存。聊天记录、收藏、备注、备注名、窗口布局和图片缓存在 %LOCALAPPDATA%\XIVChatDesktop。这些内容都不会上传。
  • **游戏插件：**设置、已信任设备和插件密钥与其他 Dalamud 插件设置保存在一起，中继凭据按你的 Windows 账户加密。插件会在内存中保留最近的消息，方便客户端重连后补齐；保留多少可以在插件的“消息”页设置，插件停止后清空。

这些目录含有聊天记录和连接凭据，请不要公开上传。

连接安全

  • **第一次连接：**客户端和插件都会显示设备指纹。核对一致后，在两边都确认允许。只允许你认识的设备；不再使用的设备可以在插件“设备”页删除。
  • **加密：**无论直连还是经过中继，客户端和插件之间的聊天数据都是加密传输的。客户端 1.6.0 和插件 1.8.0 起使用加密 v2：每次连接使用新密钥，录下的数据无法重放，设备密钥以后泄露也不影响过去的会话。更早的版本使用没有这些保护的旧版加密 (v1)，插件“设备”页会标出仍在使用旧版加密的设备。详见 聊天加密 v2。
  • **直连：**插件 1.7.17 起，新配置只允许本机直接连接。只有需要从局域网里另一台电脑连接时，才开启“允许局域网设备连接”。插件会限制陌生设备反复连接和弹出确认窗口。
  • **中继：**你自己部署的中继能看到连接地址、时间、设备标识和流量大小，但不持有设备私钥，也不保存聊天记录。详见 自建中继。

客户端会访问哪些网站

功能 服务 发送的内容 怎么控制
检查更新 GitHub（api.github.com） 普通的公开版本列表请求，不含聊天或角色信息 设置 → 更新 → 关闭启动时检查
联网头像 Lodestone（na.finalfantasyxiv.com） 客户端里显示的角色名和所属服务器，用来查找头像 设置 → 历史 → “允许联网查询 Lodestone 头像”
物品和地图卡片 xivapi.com、cafemaker.wakingsands.com、xivapi-v2.xivcdn.com 物品、图标和地图编号 第一次下载后图片会缓存在本机
地图链接 map.wakingsands.com 打开地图卡片网页时的地图编号和坐标 只在你打开时访问
翻译（客户端 1.6.0） 你选择的服务：谷歌（translate.googleapis.com）、微软（api.cognitive.microsofttranslator.com）、DeepL（api.deepl.com / api-free.deepl.com）、百度（fanyi-api.baidu.com）、腾讯（tmt.tencentcloudapi.com）或 AI 服务 你选择翻译的那条消息；开启主播模式时会隐藏名字 默认关闭，只在你操作时发送
AI 总结（客户端 1.6.0） 你设置的 AI 服务：Anthropic（api.anthropic.com）或你填写的 OpenAI 兼容地址 你选择总结的那段记录；开启主播模式时会隐藏名字 默认关闭，只在你操作时发送

和所有网络请求一样，这些服务也能看到你的 IP 地址。

截图和主播模式

已信任的客户端请求截图时，插件会截取游戏画面。插件 1.8.0 起，可以在插件“消息”页关闭“允许客户端请求游戏截图”；更早的版本没有这个开关，所以只信任你自己控制的设备。主播模式只改变客户端里显示、复制和导出的内容，不会给游戏截图、图片、未知昵称或你正在输入的文字打码，本地记录也保留原始消息。分享前请检查实际画面。

报告安全问题

请不要公开发布细节。可以 新建一个 issue，只说明你有安全问题要报告，之后会安排私下沟通的方式。
